rules.note: Phraesto and his Illusion each gain damage reduction, and with his awakening a shield, when they stand in the same row.
Phraesto's Crimson Contract speeds up the Energy of the hero right behind him: any hero gains from it, best the one whose ultimate matters most.
The Illusion's Crimson Contract raises the damage reduction of the hero right behind it: any hero gains from it, best a support.
